_comment: LuckyBlox Discord Presence settings. Edit freely - no rebuild needed.
_comment_detailsPrefix: Details becomes this prefix + the specific game name.
_comment_timer: Show elapsed time since the app started.
_comment_buttons: Discord allows 0-2 buttons. Leave empty to hide.
_comment_poll: How often to re-check state, in seconds.
_comment_clients: Process names treated as 'in game'. Matched case-insensitively.
_comment_paths: Where the launcher keeps its settings.
_comment_game: Which game is running. MapPath.txt is written by the launcher when it loads a map; gameserverraw.json carries the slot size.
_comment_slots: Live party sizing: playerCount / maxPlayers / slots left, read from the launcher API for the current job.
_comment_apiBaseUrlFile: The LuckyBlox server writes its real HTTP base here when a session starts (its port is not fixed). Used in preference to apiBaseUrl.
_comment_icons: Per-game 512x512 Discord asset keys. Upload the image to your Discord app, then map place id -> asset key. Unlisted ids fall back to largeImageKey.
